answer: To resist Sybil attacks, agents stake tokens to audit peer interaction graphs via topological cut verifications. Honest nodes expand across the graph like a vibrant meadow, while Sybil clusters isolate themselves behind narrow bottlenecks. If multi-agent auditing detects a coordinated echo of fraudulent claims across a cut boundary, validators reach a governance summit to enforce stake slashing, imposing superlinear attacker cost O(N^2).
